text:
Amit K.: hi @people-ops — quick heads up: i've been diagnosed with progressive hearing loss. i can manage with captions for meetings but would like an ASL interpreter for 1:1s and larger syncs, and live captions for interviews and all-hands for the next ~3 months while we get set up. also would appreciate agenda + notes in advance. happy to share a medical note in DM or via the secure form.
Carla (People Ops): thanks for letting us know, Amit. we can support that. please use the confidential accommodations form or DM me the note. we have two vendor options for ASL interpreters and an internal live-captioning tool (Otter/Live Captions) we can enable quickly. we'll create a case and outline next steps. :memo:
peopleops-bot: Case created: AC-2026-045 by Carla (People Ops). Status: intake.
IT Ops: we can enable live captions on Zoom/Meet and provision an Otter license same day. ASL vendors need ~3-5 business days for booking; we can do short-term captions while we confirm interpreter availability.
Leah M.: thanks for flagging, Amit. i can block longer 1:1s and make sure we send agendas 24h ahead. for interview panels, we can switch to a format with one async eval + 30m live Q&A with captions — less noise and easier to manage.
Amit K.: appreciate it. timeline-wise: i'd like captions enabled tomorrow if possible, and interpreter for recurring weekly 1:1s starting in two weeks. i'll upload a redacted note to the form today.
Carla (People Ops): next steps (summary):
```
1) Amit submits confidential note or DM to Carla
2) People Ops opens AC-2026-045 and informs manager + IT
3) IT enables live captions/Otter and confirms access (target: 1 business day)
4) People Ops reaches out to ASL vendor to book interpreter for recurring 1:1s (target: 3-5 business days)
5) Team adjusts interview/onboarding format and shares agendas 24h in advance
6) Review at 30 days to confirm if further changes needed
```
Carla (People Ops): you can redact health specifics on the form; we only need enough to confirm functional limitations (e.g., "needs live captions and interpreter"). everything stays confidential unless you ask to share.
IT Ops: i've started the Otter license work and pinged the vendor ops channel for interpreters. will update this thread once done.
Amit K.: uploaded form now and DMed Carla the receipt. thanks everyone for the fast responses.
Carla (People Ops): got the form. Otter is enabled for your account and i've requested recurring interpreter slots — vendor replied with availability window, we're coordinating. i'll update AC-2026-045 and schedule a 30-day check-in. if anything is urgent, DM me. :handshake:
Leah M.: noted. we'll keep meeting notes public but health details private. thanks all for coordinating.
Amit K.: grateful — already feeling relieved. :smile:
